summary: Verification-only run. The ticket deliverable was already implemented and pushed as PR #6, so this run read the existing change, re-verified it against every scope item and acceptance criterion, and refreshed the completion report. No content edits were required: the page at 06-modules/reactory-azure/README.md is 1,005 lines with all eleven required areas, an explicit licence reconciliation (MIT / example-only authoritative; 'commercial' in three server registry files recorded as the defect and routed), a ten-step worked example mapped to real files and lines, and a 105-citation evidence index. One source-side item cannot be fixed in this docs worktree (registry licence value) and is tracked by open follow-up ticket REACTORY-302016408/20261019/923623068.
